what: One firmware, many synths: hold HOME and pick CS-1, Scintilla (the Elka Synthex), OberVave or a sine, no reflashing. Add PROPHET, B3 ORGAN, Niagara Drift, ARTIHIVE, FM-106, FM-1 SID, AMB-1, FoMni, MONK-1, FiMba-1, GATOR, DUB-1, FMINI-1, FM6 or ATEK303 from the page with one click, and your own modules over USB. A master EQ, MIDI options, BLE-MIDI, the second core, a MIDI test page, and the log and crash record in the browser.
